raw:
Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 2  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified Universal Music Group (UMG) as the "only group larger than Långa nätter's record label" based on size, without verifying if UMG was indeed the sole larger entity. This assumption led to the focus on Hilversum, Netherlands (UMG's corporate HQ), instead of thoroughly investigating other possibilities or confirming RCA Records' exact position in the hierarchy. This premature decision set the course of the investigation in the wrong direction, ultimately leading to the incorrect solution.
